messages.subject: Subsetting rules from apriori algorithm doesn´t work
parts:
Hello guys. I know it could be "trivial" but I can´t get it.

I Have a shiny App which I use to make some market basket analysis. The situation is that I am trying to get only a subset of the rules produced by the apriori algorithm. The variables for which I should subset the rules are shown when I select the "Filtrar" option (conditionalPanel) and once I select one or several options, the LHS (left hand side) of the rules should be filtered. How could I get rules only with LHS containing what I choose in "Lado Izquierdo".

Additionaly, I wonder where should I read my csv file? Is it correct where I am reading my dataset?

Any help will be appreciated.

My code is as follow and I attach a sample of my dataset.

library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(arules)

server<-function(input, output, session) {
  library(plyr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(arules)
  transactions_todos <- read.csv("data_rules.csv", sep=";")
  for(i in 1:ncol(transactions_todos)){transactions_todos[,i]<-as.factor(transactions_todos[,i])}
    tableData <- reactive({
    df<-filter(transactions_todos, YEAR==input$anio & STORE==input$tienda & CUSTOMER==input$cliente & CATEGORY==input$categoria)

      varsL <- character()

        tmp <- with(transactions_todos, paste(input$opcs[i]))
        varsL <- c(varsL, tmp)
      }

      ar <- subset(reglas_todos, subset=lhs %pin% input$opcs)
      rules_df<-as(ar, "data.frame")
      df_reglas<-data.frame(Antecedente = labels(lhs(reglas_todos), setStart = "", setEnd = ""),
                            Consecuente = labels(rhs(reglas_todos), setStart = "", setEnd = ""),
                            Regla= rules_df$rules,
                            Soporte=round(rules_df$support,4),
                            Confianza=round(rules_df$confidence,4),
                            Lift=round(rules_df$lift,4))
      df_reglas$Antecedente<-gsub(",",", ",df_reglas$Antecedente)
      df_reglas$Consecuente<-gsub(",",", ",df_reglas$Consecuente)
      df_reglas$Regla<-gsub(",",", ",df_reglas$Regla)
      df_reglas[,-c(3)]
    }
    else {
      rules_df<-as(reglas_todos, "data.frame")
      df_reglas<-data.frame(Antecedente = labels(lhs(reglas_todos), setStart = "", setEnd = ""),
                            Consecuente = labels(rhs(reglas_todos), setStart = "", setEnd = ""),
                            Regla= rules_df$rules,
                            Soporte=round(rules_df$support,4),
                            Confianza=round(rules_df$confidence,4),
                            Lift=round(rules_df$lift,4))
      df_reglas$Antecedente<-gsub(",",", ",df_reglas$Antecedente)
      df_reglas$Consecuente<-gsub(",",", ",df_reglas$Consecuente)
      df_reglas$Regla<-gsub(",",", ",df_reglas$Regla)
      df_reglas[,-c(3)]
    }
  })
  output$contents <- renderDataTable({
    reg<-tableData()
    
  })
  br()
  br()
  output$muestrav<-renderDataTable({
    reg<-tableData()
    rules_df<-as(reg, "data.frame")
    rules_df$Regla<-paste(rules_df$Antecedente, rules_df$Consecuente, sep = " => ")
    rules_df<-rules_df[c(1:input$lgregla),c(1:5)]
  })
  output$tabla<-renderDataTable({
    reg<-tableData()
    rules_df<-as(reg, "data.frame")

  })
}

      ##### HERE IS WHERE I AM NOT ABLE TO SUBSET MY RULES

    }
  })
